# SetSamplerLodMin <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetSamplerLodMin:Void sampler:Int32, lod:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sampler` | In | Int32 | required | The sampler to change. |
| `lod` | In | Float32 | required | The lowest level, 0 or more. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets the biggest mip level that may be used, as the number of levels counted from level 0, which is the whole texture. A minimum of 1 never shows level 0, which is also a cheap way of making a texture blurrier. 0 is the default. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals read every texture with the settings of its flags and do not have samplers.
